name: Ethereal Prison
desc1: This large, brilliant chamber is crafted from pure mana, and exists
desc2: outside the normal fabric of space and time. Waves of warm, rainbow-
desc3: hued energy ripple through the room, filling you with vital force. A
desc4: strange feeling of otherworldy intelligence surrounds you on all
desc5: sides, making you feel distinctly vulnerable and unimportant.
